sn7.2:1.1: Ekam samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandaka-nivāpe || || 2.
sn7.2:2.1: Bhāradvājagotto kira brāhmaṇo Samaṇassa Gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito ti || || 3. Kupito anattamano yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosati paribhāsati || || 4. Evaṃ vutte Bhagavā akkosaka-bhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇam etad avoca || ||
sn7.2:2.3: api nu kho te āgacchanti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā atithiyo ti || || 5.
sn7.2:2.4: Appekadā me bho Gotama āgacchanti mittāmaccā ñātisālohitā atithiyo ti || || 6.
sn7.2:2.5: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi brāhmaṇa || api nu tesam anuppadesi khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyam sāyanīyan ti || || 7.
sn7.2:2.6: Appekadā nesāhaṃ bho Gotama anuppademi khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ sāyanīyan ti || || 8.
sn7.2:2.7: Sace kho pana te brāhmaṇa na patigaṇhanti kassa taṃ hoti || || 9.
sn7.2:2.8: Sace te bho Gotama na patigaṇhanti amhākam eva taṃ hotī ti || || 10.
sn7.2:2.9: Evam eva kho brāhmaṇa yaṃ tvaṃ amhe anakkosante akkosasi || arosante rosesi || abhaṇḍante bhaṇḍasi || taṃ te mayaṃ na paṭigaṇhāma
sn7.2:3.1: Yo kho brāhmaṇa akkosantaṃ paccakkosati || rosentaṃ paṭiroseti || bhaṇḍantaṃ paṭibhaṇḍati || ayam vuccati brāhmaṇa sambhuñjati vītiharati ||
sn7.2:3.2: te mayam tayā neva sambhuñjāma || na vītiharāma ||
sn7.2:3.5: Bhavantaṃ kho Gotamaṃ sarājikā parisā evaṃ jānāti ||
sn7.2:3.7: Atha ca pana bhavaṃ Gotamo kujjhatī ti || || 12.
sn7.2:8.1: Evaṃ vutte akkosaka-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn7.2:8.3: Esāham bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇam gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca || ||
sn7.2:8.4: Labheyyāham bhoto Gotamassa santike pabbajjaṃ labheyyam upasampadan ti || || 14.
sn7.2:9.1: Alattha kho akkosaka-bhāradvājo brāhmaṇo Bhagavato santike pabbajjaṃ alattha upasampadaṃ || 15.
sn7.2:9.2: Acirūpasampanno kho panāyasmā akkosaka-bhāradvājo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭhevadhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi ||
sn7.2:9.3: khīnā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karanīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti abbhaññāsi || || 16.
sn7.2:9.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā Bhāradvājo arahatam ahosī ti || || 1.
